description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance across different curriculum sampling strategies for dense retrieval, as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 2 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linear and spans integer values from 2 to 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is also linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.5. The plot displays six distinct lines, each representing a different sampling method: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line), “DPR w/ gold” (yellow solid line with circular markers), “DPR w/ top-1” (green solid line with circular markers), “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple dashed line with circular markers), “DPR w/ random” (blue dashed line with circular markers), and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red dashed line with circular markers). The “DPR w/o query” line remains constant at 34.0 throughout the range. The “DPR w/ gold” line starts at 33.0 when S=2, rises to 35.0 at S=4, and continues to increase to 35.0 at S=10. The “DPR w/ top-1” line begins at 34.5 when S=2, rises sharply to 36.5 at S=10, and passes through 35.5 at S=4. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line starts at 35.0 when S=2, dips slightly to 34.5 at S=4, and then remains relatively flat around 34.5 until S=10. The “DPR w/ random” line begins at 34.5 when S=2, remains relatively flat around 35.0 until S=10, and ends at 35.0. The “DPR w/ curriculum” line starts at 35.0 when S=2, remains relatively flat around 35.5 until S=10, and ends at 35.5.
